outlooks.summary: SPORADIC STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...WITH POSSIBLE TORNADOES...WILL OCCUR THROUGH EARLY WEDNESDAY OVER THE CENTRAL AND EASTERN GULF COAST REGION. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS MAY OCCUR OVER PARTS OF GEORGIA AND SOUTHERN SOUTH CAROLINA...AND OVER FAR SOUTHEAST TEXAS.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: BROAD CNTRL U.S. TROUGH WILL CONTINUE SLOWLY EWD THIS PERIOD AS UPSTREAM RIDGE TEMPORARILY BUILDS NE INTO THE GRT BASIN. JET STREAKS NOW OVER THE SRN RCKYS AND CNTRL TX WILL SERVE TO RE-ORIENT THE CNTRL STATES TROUGH...WITH A NEW CLOSED CENTER EXPECTED TO EVOLVE OVER MO AS EXISTING ONE SHEARS NNE TO THE UPR GRT LKS. AT THE SFC...EXPANSIVE CORRIDOR OF SEASONABLY WARM/INCREASINGLY MOIST AIR WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD N/NE ACROSS THE CNTRL AND ERN GULF CST REGION...AHEAD OF LEAD COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED CNTRL U.S. TROUGH. THAT FRONT...NOW OVER NW LA/SE TX...WILL BE REINFORCED LATER TODAY BY A NEW COOL AIR SURGE ASSOCIATED WITH THE SRN RCKYS IMPULSE. THE STRENGTHENED BOUNDARY SHOULD THEN CONTINUE E/SE ACROSS THE CNTRL GULF CST STATES TNGT/EARLY WED.

sections.title: CNTRL/ERN GULF CST REGION TO S ATLANTIC CST THROUGH EARLY WED
sections.text: A BROAD...SOMEWHAT UNFOCUSED...BUT APPRECIABLE SVR RISK WILL EXIST OVER THE CNTRL GULF CST REGION EWD TO THE S ATLANTIC CST THROUGH EARLY WED AS STRONG SWLY MID-UPR LVL FLOW PERSISTS ATOP WIDE CORRIDOR OF LOW-LVL MOISTURE RETURN AHEAD OF WRN LA/E TX COLD FRONT. RE-ORIENTATION OF LARGE-SCALE TROUGH BETWEEN NOW AND WEDNESDAY WILL KEEP STRONGEST FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH ABOVE-MENTIONED JET STREAKS W OF SFC WARM SECTOR. NEVERTHELESS...GLANCING INFLUENCE OF THESE FEATURES...COUPLED WITH FILTERED SFC HEATING AND WEAK UPLIFT ALONG NUMEROUS SSW-NNE LOW-LVL WARM SECTOR CONFLUENCE LINES EXPECTED TO SUPPORT FAIRLY WIDESPREAD TSTM COVERAGE THROUGH THE PERIOD FROM LA EWD INTO PARTS OF MS...AL...FL...AND GA. AMPLE DEEP SWLY SHEAR...COUPLED WITH NOTABLE RESIDUAL EML ALOFT /SAMPLED BY 12Z LCH AND LIX RAOBS/ AND SEASONABLY RICH MOISTURE /PW APPROACHING 2 INCHES/ SUGGEST LIKELIHOOD FOR SCTD SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS...AND BROKEN LINES/CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DMGG WIND...OCCASIONAL TORNADOES...AND SVR HAIL THROUGH EARLY TNGT. WITH TIME...STRENGTHENING WRN LA/E TX COLD FRONT SHOULD SERVE AS THE PRIMARY FOCUS FOR CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT...WITH AN EXTENSIVE SQLN LIKELY TO EVOLVE ALONG IT.

outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLE TORNADOES...WILL OCCUR THROUGH EARLY WEDNESDAY OVER THE CENTRAL AND EASTERN GULF COAST REGION. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS MAY OCCUR OVER PARTS OF GEORGIA AND SOUTHERN SOUTH CAROLINA.

sections.title: 20Z UPDATE
sections.text: OVERALL FORECAST SCENARIO REMAINS LARGELY UNCHANGED...WITH THE PRIMARY SEVERE POTENTIAL STILL EXPECTED WITHIN A CORRIDOR ACROSS EASTERN LA/SOUTHEAST MS INTO SOUTHERN AL/FL PANHANDLE THROUGH THIS EVENING. SURFACE PRESSURE FALLS ARE CURRENTLY MAXIMIZED ACROSS EASTERN LA INTO SOUTHERN/EASTERN MS IN CONJUNCTION WITH A DEEPENING FRONTAL WAVE ACROSS THE NORTHWEST GULF OF MEXICO/SOUTHERN LA. THIS SCENARIO WILL CONTINUE TO CONTRIBUTE TO ADDITIONAL LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE/CONVERGENCE AS A MARITIME AIR MASS CONTINUES TO MOVE INLAND. A HIGHLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT TORNADO/DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL...PARTICULARLY WITHIN THE AFOREMENTIONED CORRIDOR. OTHERWISE...MARGINAL RISK-RELATED PROBABILITIES WERE EXPANDED ACROSS ADDITIONAL PORTIONS OF THE TN VALLEY VICINITY MAINLY FOR A HAIL/WIND RISK. ..GUYER.. 12/23/2014 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1154 AM CST TUE DEC 23 2014/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING RISK OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...INCLUDING TORNADOES...THIS MORNING. THE ISSUANCE OF A TORNADO WATCH WILL BE POSSIBLE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MOISTURE-CHANNEL IMAGERY IMPLIES THAT THE LEADING EDGE OF STRONGER DCVA PRECEDING A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CROSSING THE SRN PLAINS IS ENCROACHING UPON THE WRN EXTENT OF INLAND-EXTENDING GULF MOISTURE -- E.G. MIDDLE 60S SFC DEWPOINTS ANALYZED ACROSS SRN LA/MS. SMALL...SHALLOW REFLECTIVITY CORES ARE NOW BEING DETECTED FROM E-CNTRL TX TO SWRN LA. THIS IS EVIDENCE OF THE INTERACTION OF STRONGER ASCENT OVERTAKING THE WRN FRINGES OF NON-ZERO BUOYANCY...WITH SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW LAYERS EXISTING E OF A SFC TROUGH ANALYZED FROM N-CNTRL AL TO VICKSBURG MS TO NEAR BEAUMONT TX. E OF THIS TROUGH...LIX/LCH RAOBS AT 12Z SAMPLE AROUND 1250 J/KG OF MLCAPE AIDED BY MODESTLY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. INLAND PENETRATION OF HIGHER-BUOYANCY/THETA-E AIR WILL BE FACILITATED BY STRENGTHENING POLEWARD MASS FLUXES PRECEDING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH...WITH RELATED ASCENT RESULTING IN A BLOSSOMING OF CONVECTION NEAR/E OF THE SFC TROUGH THIS MORNING. WITH AREA VWPS SAMPLING 50-60 KT OF 0-6-KM BULK SHEAR...MIXED-MODE CONVECTION INCLUDING SUPERCELLS/QLCS SEGMENTS SHOULD ENSUE...WITH DMGG WIND GUSTS AND SVR HAIL POSSIBLE. ELONGATING/CURVED LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS MAY ALSO SUPPORT A FEW TORNADOES...ESPECIALLY WITH MORE DISCRETE CONVECTION EVOLVING ACROSS SRN LA/SRN MS WHICH WILL BE IN CONTACT WITH RICHEST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. ULTIMATELY...UNCERTAINTY IN THE TIMING OF THE MORE SUBSTANTIAL INCREASE IN SVR-TSTM POTENTIAL EXTENDS TO WW ISSUANCE TIMING. BY MID DAY...A WW WILL PROBABLY BE REQUIRED...THOUGH WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE IN THE SHORT-TERM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GRADUAL INCREASE IN SEVERE RISK OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS ACROSS THE CENTRAL GULF COASTAL REGION AND FL PANHANDLE VICINITY MAY EVENTUALLY NECESSITATE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE COVERAGE AND INTENSITY IS UNDERWAY ACROSS THE GULF OF MEXICO AND ADJACENT S CENTRAL/SERN U.S. ATTM...WITHIN A BROAD AREA OF STRENGTHENING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT AHEAD OF SHORT-WAVE TROUGHING WHICH CONTINUES TO DIG ESEWD ACROSS THE RIO GRANDE VALLEY REGION. THE INLAND BOUNDARY-LAYER AIRMASS ACROSS GA AND ERN AL SHOULD REMAIN COOL/STABLE -- REINFORCED BY A COLD AIR DAMMING REGIME E/SE OF THE APPALACHIANS. HOWEVER...LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE RETURN FARTHER S AND W -- I.E. INTO THE CENTRAL AND ERN GULF COASTAL REGION -- WILL CONTINUE...WITH UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S DEWPOINTS SUPPORTING SUFFICIENT CAPE FOR FURTHER INCREASES IN CONVECTIVE COVERAGE/INTENSITY. AS STORM COVERAGE EXPANDS...MIXED STORM MODES/CLUSTERS OF CONVECTION SHOULD PREVAIL. WITH DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF UPDRAFT ROTATION ACROSS A BROAD AREA...RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL -- AND POSSIBLY A FEW TORNADOES -- WILL EXIST WITH STRONGEST CONVECTIVE ELEMENTS. GIVEN THIS POTENTIAL...WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE AREA THIS MORNING.

BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER ACROSS SERN LA INTO EXTREME SWRN MS HAVE ALLOWED SFC TEMPERATURES TO WARM INTO THE LOWER-MID 70S. RESULTANT LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE STEEPENING SLIGHTLY AND THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO MORE INSTABILITY WITHIN STRONGLY SHEARED AIR MASS ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY. WHILE MOST SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTION HAS ORIENTED ITSELF ALONG WARM FRONTAL CORRIDOR THAT HAS ADVANCED INLAND...THERE IS INCREASING CONFIDENCE THAT CONVECTION MAY GRADUALLY INTENSIFY ALONG/AHEAD COLD FRONT AS IT ENCOUNTERS MORE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR DISCRETE STRUCTURES BUT AN UPWARD EVOLVING LINEAR MCS COULD ULTIMATELY DEVELOP ALONG SURGING COLD FRONT. TORNADO THREAT REMAINS GREATEST WITH SUPERCELLS ALONG/SOUTH OF WARM FRONT. ..DARROW.. 12/23/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A GRADUAL INCREASE IN THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING OFFSHORE MAY POSE A THREAT FOR A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS OR BRIEF TORNADOES AS THEY MOVE ONSHORE THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INCREASING WAA ALOFT...IN CONJUNCTION WITH LOW-LEVEL FORCING FROM A LINE OF CONFLUENCE EXTENDING S OFFSHORE THE FL PANHANDLE...HAS LED TO A GRADUAL INCREASE IN COVERAGE OF STRONG SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS. LATEST KEVX DATA INDICATE A FEW OF THESE CELLS ARE ACQUIRING LOW/MID-LEVEL ROTATION /I.E. CELLS SSW OF PANAMA CITY/...AND THIS TREND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE AS THEY PROGRESS THROUGH AN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY EFFECTIVE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR OF 40-50 KT. HOWEVER...ONCE THESE CELLS MOVE ONSHORE...THEY WILL ENCOUNTER A THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY RELATIVELY LOWER DEW POINTS AND DECREASING MUCAPE /E.G. LESS THAN 500 J PER KG/ ACROSS THE AREA. WHILE EFFECTIVE SRH DECREASES WITH NEWD EXTENT...LATEST GUIDANCE SUPPORTS A GRADUAL INCREASE IN THE LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELD OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. FURTHERMORE...ADVECTION OF HIGHER THETA-E AIR FROM OFFSHORE WILL SUPPORT AN INCREASE IN SFC-BASED BUOYANCY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. AS SUCH...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A POTENTIAL WATCH THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS WILL INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING...WITH A RESULTANT INCREASE IN THE POSSIBILITY FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AS FORCING FOR ASCENT INCREASES DUE TO AN EWD-PROGRESSING COLD FRONT IN CONJUNCTION WITH A STRENGTHENING LLJ / WAA ALOFT...SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS THE AREA LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER...ESPECIALLY NEAR THE GULF COAST...HAVE RESULTED IN IMPROVED INSOLATION AND INCREASING BUOYANCY. WHILE MLCAPE VALUES ARE STILL MEAGER /AROUND 250-500 J PER KG/...NEWD ADVECTION OF HIGHER THETA-E VALUES AND 1-2 MORE HOURS OF INSOLATION WILL RESULT IN MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000 J PER KG. ADDITIONALLY...THE STRENGTHENING BACKGROUND FLOW FIELD WILL CONTRIBUTE TO EFFECTIVE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR VALUES INCREASING TO AROUND 50-60 KTS ACROSS THE AREA. IN COMBINATION WITH INCREASING EFFECTIVE SRH AND A MOIST BL CHARACTERIZED BY MEAN MIXING RATIOS UPWARDS OF 13-14 G/KG...A MIXTURE OF CONVECTIVE MODES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND A FEW TORNADOES WILL LIKELY CONTINUE EWD DOWNSTREAM OF WW560. AS SUCH...ISSUANCE OF A NEW WATCH IS LIKELY LATE THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO THREAT CONTINUES...ESPECIALLY ACROSS PARTS OF SOUTHEAST LA...SOUTHERN MS...AND SOUTHWEST AL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WARM FRONT IS GRADUALLY ADVANCING NWD ACROSS SERN MS AND SRN AL WITH MID 60S SFC DEW POINTS COMMON ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. WARM FRONT APPEARS TO BE JUST SOUTH OF MEI TO NEAR SEM. THIS BOUNDARY MAY YET LIFT NWD INTO CNTRL AL AS MESO LOW LOCATED NEAR MCB LIFTS NEWD. ONE LONG-LIVED...WELL DEFINED POTENTIALLY TORNADIC SUPERCELL IS MOVING QUICKLY TOWARD JONES COUNTRY MS. SHEAR REMAINS FAVORABLE FOR TORNADOES WITH THESE DISCRETE STRUCTURES...ESPECIALLY ALONG THE WARM FRONTAL CORRIDOR AHEAD OF MESO LOW. OTHERWISE...UPWARD EVOLVING COLD-FRONTAL CONVECTION MAY BE NOTED INTO THE EVENING HOURS. ..DARROW.. 12/23/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE WEATHER INCLUDING A TORNADO THREAT IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST UNTIL 02-03Z ACROSS SOUTHEAST MS AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF SOUTHWEST AL. LOCAL WFO TEMPORAL EXTENSION IS PROPOSED FOR THIS PORTION OF WW 560.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 22Z...SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWED THE WARM SECTOR REMAINED OVER FAR SERN LA THROUGH SERN MS AND SWRN AL...WITH DEW POINTS IN THE MID-UPPER 60S...AND AT OR ABOVE 70 ALONG THE GULF COAST. A CONTINUED INFLUX OF MOISTURE COUPLED WITH SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MAINTAINING A MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT INTO THE EARLY EVENING. STRONG DEEP LAYER ASCENT ALONG A STRENGTHENING SSWLY LLJ /50 KT PER MOB WSR-88D VAD/ AND AHEAD OF A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH APPROACHING THE ARKLATEX REGION IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN UPSCALE GROWTH OF A LINEAR STRUCTURE ALONG A COLD FRONT...CURRENTLY ADVANCING EWD ACROSS SRN MS AND SERN LA. STRONG EFFECTIVE SRH PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSES OF 300-400 M2/S2 SUPPORTS A CONTINUED TORNADO THREAT IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WINDS. THESE THREATS WILL BE ATTENDANT TO ANY DISCRETE STORMS IN THE WARM SECTOR...ESPECIALLY NEAR THE WARM FRONT...AND/OR WITH STORMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT. ..PETERS.. 12/23/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: IN THE SHORT-TERM /THROUGH 02Z/...TWO PRIMARY ZONES OF WW 561 CAN EXPECT TO HAVE A CONTINUED THREAT FROM STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS. TWO NNE-SSW ORIENTED LINES OF STORMS MOVING EWD THROUGH CENTRAL AND SWRN AL AND THE WRN FL PANHANDLE WILL RESULT IN A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO OR TWO. FARTHER EAST...A SW-NE ORIENTED CORRIDOR OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO AFFECT THE ERN FL PANHANDLE INTO SWRN GA...WITH A TORNADO THREAT AND DAMAGING WINDS. SOME COUNTIES NEAR AND SOUTH OF ATLANTA GA MAY NEED TO BE ADDED TO WW 561 BY 02Z...IF THE AIR MASS CAN DESTABILIZE SUFFICIENTLY TO SUSTAIN A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT FROM A FAST-MOVING LINE OF STORMS IN CENTRAL AL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0030Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A FAST-MOVING LINE OF STORMS TRACKING ENEWD AT 40-50 KT ACROSS CENTRAL AL...WITH THESE STORMS EXTENDING FROM NRN SHELBY COUNTY SSWWD TO MONROE COUNTY. IN THIS LATTER COUNTY...THE AFOREMENTIONED LINE OF STORMS AND ATTENDANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WERE BEGINNING TO MERGE WITH A NNE-SSW ORIENTED PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE ZONE OVER SWRN AL. THE FAST-MOVING LINE OF STORMS WAS LOCATED SOUTH OF THE WRN PORTION OF A SYNOPTIC WARM FRONT WHICH EXTENDED FROM NEAR KBHM INTO WEST-CENTRAL GA /NEAR KLGC/ THEN SEWD TO THE GA COAST NORTH OF KSSI. STORMS ACROSS CENTRAL TO EAST-CENTRAL AL SHOULD PRODUCE A PRIMARY THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS...THOUGH ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR /EFFECTIVE SRH OF 300-500 M2 PER S2/ WAS OBSERVED INVOF THE STRONGEST PORTION OF THE LLJ. THIS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT LOW-LEVEL STORM ROTATION AND A TORNADO THREAT...THOUGH THIS THREAT SHOULD BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED WITH NRN EXTENT GIVEN A MORE STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER AT BHM AND FFC PER 00Z SOUNDINGS. MEANWHILE...GREATER MOISTURE /SURFACE DEW POINTS INTO THE MID 60S/ EXISTED FROM SWRN AL THROUGH THE WRN AND SRN PORTIONS OF THE FL PANHANDLE...GENERALLY ALONG A SECOND WARM FRONT MARKING THE NWD RETURN OF MARITIME-TROPICAL AIR. THIS BETTER MOISTURE CONTENT AIR MASS AND STRONGER INSTABILITY SHOULD RESULT IN A GREATER TORNADO POTENTIAL TENDING TO BE NEAR AND SOUTH OF THIS WNW-ESE ORIENTED WARM FRONT. EFFECTIVE SRH OF 200-400 M2/S2 IS MAXIMIZED ALONG THIS FRONT. ..PETERS.. 12/24/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED PRIOR TO 05Z FOR PARTS OF THE CENTRAL FL PANHANDLE INTO NORTHWEST FL AND SOUTHWEST GA. A LINE OF STORMS WILL TRACK EWD OVERNIGHT THROUGH THIS REGION...PRODUCING A POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND A TORNADO THREAT AS LOW-LEVEL SHEAR INCREASES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 04Z...MOSAIC RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A LINE OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM JUST EAST OF KATL SWWD THROUGH FAR SERN AL TO THE WRN FL PANHANDLE. LIGHTNING PRODUCTION HAS INCREASED ALONG THE PORTION OF THIS LINE IN SERN AL WHERE IR SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED COOLING CLOUD TOPS. DEEP LAYER WIND FIELDS WILL STRENGTHEN FROM THE NERN GULF INTO THE SERN STATES AS A STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVES INTO THE LOWER MS VALLEY THROUGH 12Z...WITH A 50-60 KT SSWLY LLJ TRANSLATING EWD ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. MOISTURE WILL CONTINUE TO ADVANCE POLEWARD WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE MIDDLE 60S SPREADING INTO SRN GA...WITH VALUES AROUND 70 F ALONG THE NERN GULF COAST. RECENT TRENDS IN OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED ONGOING DESTABILIZATION WITH MODERATE MUCAPE INTO THE ERN FL PANHANDLE AT 04Z. GIVEN THE EXPECTED INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL AND DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ACROSS THIS DISCUSSION AREA AND THE LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING...PARCELS WILL CONTINUE TO BECOME NEAR-SURFACE TO SURFACE-BASED FROM SOUTH TO NORTH ENHANCING THE TORNADO POTENTIAL. IN ADDITION...THERE COULD BE STORMS DEVELOPING IN THE WARM SECTOR EAST OF THE ONGOING LINE OF STORMS THAT WOULD ALSO POSE A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS OR A TORNADO OR TWO CONTINUES ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE FL PANHANDLE/N FL AND ADJACENT SWRN AND S CENTRAL GA EARLY THIS AM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT ADVANCING EWD ACROSS ERN MS ATTM...WITH A COOL CONTINENTAL WEDGE AIRMASS REMAINING IN PLACE ACROSS THE NRN HALF OF GA AND ERN AL -- BEING REINFORCED BY ONGOING/WIDESPREAD RAINFALL ACROSS THIS AREA. E OF THE COLD FRONT AND S OF THE WEDGE FRONT -- I.E. ACROSS SRN GA AND FL...A MARITIME TROPICAL AIRMASS IS EVIDENT...WITH UPPER 60S TO LOW 70S DEWPOINTS CONTRIBUTING TO WEAK /AOB 500 J/KG/ BUT SUFFICIENT MIXED-LAYER CAPE TO SUPPORT SURFACE-BASED STORMS. THE STRONGEST STORMS ARE ONGOING WITHIN A BAND FROM THE CENTRAL FL PANHANDLE NEWD INTO SWRN GA...WHERE FAVORABLY STRONG LOW-LEVEL DIRECTIONAL AND SPEED SHEAR IS INDICATED PER AREA VWPS. THIS HAS SUPPORTED NUMEROUS -- BUT RELATIVELY WEAK/TRANSIENT -- LOW-LEVEL CYCLONIC CIRCULATIONS OVER THE PAST COUPLE OF HOURS...WITH ONE RELATIVELY STRONGER COUPLET NOW OVER SRN EARLY COUNTY GA APPROACHING NWRN MILLER CO ATTM. EXPECT A RELATIVELY STEADY-STATE BACKGROUND SITUATION TO PERSIST -- I.E. WITH PERSISTENT CONVECTION ALONG WITH OCCASIONAL LOW-LEVEL ROTATION WITHIN STRONGER STORMS ACROSS THIS AREA. POTENTIAL REMAINS FOR BRIEF ENHANCEMENTS TO THE LOW-LEVEL ROTATION OF ANY CELL...WHICH COULD ALLOW QUICK SPIN-UP OF A TORNADO OR TWO AT ANY TIME ACROSS THE WW AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LIMITED SEVERE/ISOLATED TORNADO RISK CONTINUES -- AND WILL PERSIST BEYOND THE SCHEDULED 24/12Z EXPIRATION OF WW 562 -- THUS LIKELY REQUIRING NEW WW ISSUANCE ACROSS THE CURRENT WW AREA AND TO THE E.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST AN INCREASINGLY BANDED/LINEAR EVOLUTION TO THE CONVECTION ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF WW 562 -- I.E. FROM S CENTRAL GA SWWD INTO THE CENTRAL FL PANHANDLE. AS THE SYNOPTIC STORM SYSTEM CONTINUES EWD...EXPECT LINEAR EVOLUTION TO CONTINUE ALONG/AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT...WITH STRONGER EMBEDDED CELLS REMAINING CAPABLE OF LOCALLY GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS AND A COUPLE OF TORNADOES. MEANWHILE...PERSISTENT SLY SURFACE WINDS ACROSS THE FL/S GA/SRN ATLANTIC COASTAL AREAS CONTINUE TO ERODE THE SRN FRINGE OF THE DAMMING AIRMASS...WITH UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 DEWPOINTS NOW IN PLACE ACROSS SERN GA AND NOSING INTO FAR SERN SC. THOUGH THE MAIN FOCUS FOR STRONGER STORMS WILL REMAIN INVOF THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT...LIMITED SHORTER-TERM RISK FOR ISOLATED/ROTATING CELLS HAS INCREASED ACROSS SERN GA AND SERN SC. EVENTUALLY...GREATER SEVERE RISK ASSOCIATED WITH THE MAIN CONVECTIVE BAND WILL SPREAD INTO THIS REGION AS WELL -- I.E. E OF THE CURRENT WW 562. THEREFORE...WITH WW 562 SCHEDULED TO EXPIRE AT 24/12Z...NEW WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED -- AND WILL EXTEND EWD TO THE SERN SC/GA COAST.
